scope: Native same-account delayed login request 107, first correlated reply and unread response.
setup: Finder copied Hotline19 to the System 9 root. First launch created the dedicated administrator account and loaded Agreement.txt. Sound Manager was unavailable. General and banner options were inspected and cancelled. An earlier Finder disk-copy attempt raised a space dialog. The installed native folder and its two fork hashes identify the tested copy.
projections: Readiness receipts retain all fields with local absolute paths shortened to basenames. Original receipt digests identify the private records. The screenshots show this disposable guest.
limitations: The driver closed after its matching ACK. Complete packet views include a later notification; driver consumption ended before that frame. Source predicts an effective client version; this experiment did not exercise a version-gated operation.
